purpose: Define Studio import/export as explicit serialization operations over canonical data, projections and presets; JSON/CSV/files remain data formats only.

topics.name: Import and Export
topics.purpose: Define Studio import/export as explicit serialization operations over canonical data, projections and presets; JSON/CSV/files remain data formats only.

semantics.format_rule: JSON, CSV and other files are serialization/data formats only.
semantics.namespace_rule: Import/export command families may be recursively hierarchical; family roots need not be executable.
semantics.export_rule: Export selects explicit source semantics/projections and a format.
semantics.import_rule: Imported data is inert until schema/identity validation and explicit application.
semantics.identity_rule: Filename/path does not define semantic identity.
semantics.round_trip_rule: Claimed semantic round-trip must preserve its declared semantic surface.
semantics.authority_rule: Import contents cannot grant authority or select arbitrary semantic roots.

invariants.rule: Studio surfaces compose or project existing canonical semantics and do not become parallel authorities.

hard_gates.condition: serialization format treated as domain semantics
import payload grants authority or arbitrary root selection
